image_description: A red rectangular sign mounted horizontally on beige horizontal siding. The sign features large, distorted white lettering that appears to be gibberish or melted text ('NISCP' followed by illegible characters). There is a small circular emblem on the left side of the sign. The sign lacks a vertical post and appears attached directly to the wall.

The small circular emblem on the left lacks clear internal structure. The edges of the white letters show slight bleeding and warping into the red background, indicating poor boundary definition.
